en: Emergency! All hands to\nthe bridge, on the double!
What's the matter, Coro!?\nAre we under attack!?

E-everyone! Things are
bad! The worst sort of
emergency! But we have
to keep it together. DO
NOT PANIC!

Perhaps some tea would
help you all relax. Oh,
speaking of which, there
happens to be some
bright-yellow tea right
here.

Looks good, yes? It is my
very own banana-plum
infusion. Allow me to
quickly chug this, and...
First, just settle down!
Oh, my apologies!
Tell us, Coro, what\nhappened?
We received an\nemergency signal from\nKurt! I will play it now!
Everyooone, heeelp.
That's Kurt, all right. His\nvoice sounds deadpan\neven in a crisis...
I must disagree! I detect\nan undeniable urgency in\nhis tone!
Long story short, he asks\nus to go to <font color=yellow>the planet\nViret</font>, near Levarance.
I am afraid it would mean\nbacktracking a long way\nfrom Earth...
What shall we do,\nCaptain?
Set a course for Viret!
Earth is more urgent.
Let's decide over a cup of\ntea.
You're right, we should\nhurry back!
Kurt is a true friend! He\neven helped us survive\nthe Purge!

Indeed! It warms my heart
to see your concern for
the people of my
homeworld.
Changing course for the\nplanet Viret! Hold tight,\nKurt!
<player>, I know Earth is\nyour goal.

But Levarance is my
home. I'm indebted to Kurt
and his friends for keeping
it safe.
If they're in some kind of\ntrouble, I can't just sit\nback and do nothing.
...Can't we go back?
I'll take the mini shuttle on\nmy own if I have to.
Well said, Captain! We\ncan't let Verda go into an\nunknown situation alone.
Let's all go to Viret\ntogether.
Thank you so much... I'm\nsorry to ask so much of\neveryone.
Changing course for the\nplanet Viret! Hold tight,\nKurt!

I was hoping you would
say that! I assure you, my
banana-plum tea is not to
be missed!

Finally, a tea that
combines the glutamic
acid of kelp, the citric acid
of plums, and the
wonderful sweetness of
banana!
The bright yellow color is\na little... unnatural. But I\nsuppose it's worth a try.
...Gulp!
Oh my!!!
Wh-what IS this!? It's\nsweet, sour, bitter, and\nspicy all at once!
Honestly, Coro! Did you\neven taste it!?
Huh? Of course not.
I lack the capacity to eat\nor drink physical\nsubstances.
Look, the captain loves it.\nRight, Captain?
Best. Tea. Ever!!!
You call this tea!? Pah!
Got any snacks to go with\nit?
And how! I love it, too! I\ncould drink another cup or\nfive right now.
You agree, right, Eve?
I-I, er... Well...
(Do they not have taste\nbuds!?)
(Or is it me? Do I lack a\nsophisticated palate!?)
L-look, enough about the\ntea!
Captain, are we heading\nfor Viret or not?

We are? Thank you,
Captain! It warms my
heart to see your concern
for the people of my
homeworld!
Changing course for the\nplanet Viret! Hold tight,\nKurt!
Eeep!

Please, calm down! The
tea may not be to your
taste, but there was no
need to flip the table in
disgust!

That said, I admire your
fervor. I never knew you
felt so passionately about
tea!

I will save the video to the
highlights folder: "Captain
flips out over fabulous
infusion!"
...Coro, you're unreal.
Anyway, Captain, what's\nthe plan? Are we heading\nfor Viret or not?

We are? Thank you,
Captain! It warms my
heart to see your concern
for the people of my
homeworld!
Changing course for the\nplanet Viret! Hold tight,\nKurt!
Oh, fine, I'll share my\ncookies with you.
Hmm, they look and smell\nnormal enough... I'll just try\na small one, too.
Huh? Why are you staring\nat me like that, Verda?
You just ate one, didn't\nyou, Eve? Ehehehehe...
Hey, hold on! You'd better\nnot have put anything\nweird in these, Verda!
Oh, it's nothing harmful.\nDon't worry about it...\nEhehehehee.
Seriously! What's in them!?\nWhat did you feed me!?
Sorry to break up this\nlively discussion, but do\nwe have a conclusion?
Shall we head back to the\nplanet Viret, or proceed\non course?
Roger that. Changing\ncourse for the planet\nViret! Hold tight, Kurt!
'Sup, guys? Thanks for\ncoming.
Kurt, what's wrong!? You\nsent a distress signal...
It's about Val and Terry...\nThey kinda left and\nhaven't come back.
What'll I do without them?\nIf they don't come back,\nI'm screwed.
Kurt, it's okay! We're here\nto help, so just tell us\nwhat happened.
Right. Thank you...

Lately, we've been working
on taking down the pulse
towers scattered across
the planets in this area.
Val and Terry were\nworking on one here on\nViret.

It was all going fine until
they stopped sending
their routine messages to
HQ on Levarance.
I tried contacting them in\nall sortsa ways, but\nnothing... Not a peep.

The tower still seems to
be operational. Our
close-range sensors are
picking up interference
signals.
In other words, we can't\nget a read on what's going\non inside?
Unfortunately not.

The only way around it is
to place some devices to
cut through the
interference, like we did
on planet Maere.

Well, no use twiddling our
thumbs. We need to move
if we want to solve this
thing.
Let's look for Val and\nTerry in the tower. Do you\nknow the way, Kurt?
Yeah, leave it to me. I\nchecked the map a little\nwhile ago.
What the!? Did the barrier\njust close on its own?
Wh-what's going on!?\nWhat's with this smoke?
Hold on, I'll see what it\nsays on this terminal!
Uh-oh...
What does it say, Verda?
Apparently, this place is\nequipped with a special\ndefense mechanism.
It closes all access points\nand releases a toxic gas.
What!? You mean we're\nsealed in here until we...
...This looks like the end of\nthe road, folks.
C-Coro! Can't you do\nsomething from there!?

It's no good, he can't hear
you. There's an
electromagnetic storm
blocking any
transmissions.
No... Do you think this is\nwhat happened to Val and\nTerry?
It seems probable.
(How awful... Then poor\nKurt will be...)
Hey, where's Kurt!?
That's strange... Where IS\nKurt!?
Oh, me? I'm right here.
What are you doing over\nthere!?

I just went to get the key
card to open the barrier
from that terminal over
there.
Look, it opened.
It seems like each terminal\nhas a key card to open a\ndifferent barrier.

So we need to get the key
card from the terminal
linked to the barrier we
want to open?
Yeah, I think so.
Nice work, Kurt! You really\ndo know your way around\nthis tower.

Not that well, really. I just
checked the map first, is
all. Never hurts to do
some basic research.
Wait, what are you trying\nto say?
C'mon, let's get going.
I know Val and Terry are\nalive. We've just gotta\nsave them.
Wait, Kurt!
<player>, Eve, let's hurry\nafter him!
<font color=yellow>Barrier Key Cards</font> can be\nacquired from Battle\nMissions.

Explore a variety of routes
and use the Barrier Key
Cards you collect to
advance.
Kurt, slow down! We can't\nkeep up!
Eek!
The barrier closed!
Oh, no... Without Kurt, we\ndon't know which terminal\nlinks to which barrier.
Argh!
It's no good... I can't hack\nproperly in these\nconditions.
Huh? Hey, what're you\nguys doin' here!?
Terry! You're alive!
I'd love to stand here and\nchat, but this toxic gas is\nkind of a buzzkill.
C'mon, I'll take ya\nsomewhere safe!

Welcome to the Safety
Zone. You'll be fine here.
That gas loses its bite by
the time it reaches this
spot.

Me an' Val have been usin'
this as our base while we
try to rescue some
buddies of ours stuck in
this tower.
So Val's okay too? That's\na relief.
For now, yeah. I don't\nthink this place'll hold\nforever, though...
Isn't there some way to\nstop the gas or open the\nentrance barrier?
Not from here. We could\ndo both from the <font color=yellow>Central\nControl Room</font>, though.

If only we could find a
route there... This tower's
defense systems are
crazy complicated.
We're in a tight spot, then.

Anyway, I'm seriously
shocked to see you guys. I
thought you'd be halfway
around the universe by
now.
We came back after Kurt\nsent a distress call. He\nsaid you had vanished.

Ah, that explains it. We're
cut off from the outside
world in here, so there
was no way of lettin' him
know.
Sorry 'bout all this... I\nguess we really put ya\nout.
Kurt must've been worried\nsick, too.
Say, where IS Kurt,\nanyway?
Actually, we just got\nseparated by a closing\nbarrier.
He ran off with way more\nenergy than you'd ever\nexpect Kurt to have...
I suspect he was terrified\nof being left alone after\nyou two vanished on him.
I can relate.
Poor Kurt...
You're right, Captain! We\nmust act now, not despair.\nLet's go after Kurt!

We have to hurry if we
want to catch him. He
seemed to know this
tower like the back of his
hand.
(...He did?)

Hey, I've got a question.
Did Kurt look over a map
of the tower before you
guys came?
Yes, he said he checked\none.

In that case, he's probably
takin' the most direct
route to the Central
Control Room.
You think he knows the\nway?
I think that guy has some\nkinda photographic\nmemory.
A photographic memory?\nPeople actually have\nthose?
Well, his brother <font color=yellow>Ralph</font>\nsure did.

One glance at a map and
he'd remember everything
from the ventilation to the
wiring to the coffee stain
in the corner.
I betcha Kurt is the same\nway.
That explains why he was\nso sure of himself earlier.\nIt all makes sense now.
Anyway, if we know where\nhe's goin', there's no time\nto waste. Let's find him!
I'll access the surveillance\ncams from this terminal.\nWe can find him on those.
I'll help with that!
Much obliged, Verda.
<player>, would you and\nthe others go tell Val\nabout Kurt?
Leave it to us. Come on,\nlet's go!
Val!
Wh-whoa! You guys! What\nare you doing in a war\nzone like this!?
We'll explain back at the\nSafety Zone.
What is Kurt thinking,\nrunning off like that!?
Did you find Kurt on the\nsurveillance cameras,\nTerry!?
Not yet... Still nothin'.

What should we do, Val?
What if Kurt tries to save
us in the same way as
Ralph, and...
Don't even say that!
Ralph is Kurt's older\nbrother with the amazing\nmemory, right?
That's right. An amazing\nfriend whose amazing\nmemory saved our butts.
Anyway, no time to waste.\nI'm headed for the Central\nControl Room.
What're ya talkin' about!?\nYou don't even know how\nto get there!
It's no use just charging\noff blindly. The gas will get\nyou in no time!
I swore to take care of\nKurt, no matter what! I'm\nbringing him back!

We still have another trick
up our sleeve first? What
do you mean by that,
Cap!?
I know what you're saying.\nIt's time for me to do what\nI'm good at: hacking!

I've been pulling data from
these terminals, and now
I've finally got an idea of
the layout here.

Just hold tight! I'll find a
route to the Central
Control Room before you
know it!
Let's just wait and trust in\nVerda.
Argh, I can't take it\nanymore! I'm done waiting\naround!
Settle down, Val! It's only\nbeen a few seconds!
How am I supposed to\nsettle down!? Kurt could\nbe DYING right now!

I'm going! I'll rescue our
allies and get as far as I
can! Better that than
doing nothing.
Oh, you'll help? Thanks,\nCaptain! You're a real pal!
Come on, let's see how far\nwe can get!

We can't go any farther
than this, Val. Come on,
let's head back to the
Safety Zone!
I guess you're right. It's\nlooking pretty toxic past\nthis point...
Alright, let's head back!
Huh? You want to know\nwhat happened with\nRalph?
I guess I should tell you,\nfor Kurt's sake.
C'mon, I'll talk while we\nrun!
Terry, Ralph, and I met\nabout two years ago...

It was in Residential
Sector 8, around the time
when all that chaos from
the Devil's Plague hit the
news.
The sector evacuation\nsirens were at full blast...

...and the transport lifts
had broken down from a
power grid failure, so a
ton of people were
stranded.

There's no help coming.
The only way out of this is
if we work together and
make for the shuttle deck.

He seemed pretty laid
back, but was also
incredibly smart. He made
a good leader.

Without his memory and
leadership, Terry and I
would've stayed glued to
the spot with no clue what
to do.
Val, Ralph! Hurry up and\nget on the shuttle with\neveryone else!
Okay, got it! We'll head\nyour way as soon as we\nhave this cargo loaded!
Phew, that was close! We\nonly made it to this deck\nthanks to you!
We never would've made it\nin time if you hadn't shown\nus that shortcut!

I owe you, too, Val. We
couldn't have come this
way if you hadn't helped
smash down that wall.
Ha, that little thing? It'd\ntake a lot more than that\nto stop me.
Alright, we're fully loaded.\nC'mon, let's get on the\nshuttle!
What're you doin', Ralph?\nHurry up, we're out of\ntime.
...I'm not going.
What are you talkin'\nabout!? We don't have\ntime for this!
I'm not doing so good. I...I\nseem to have caught the\nDevil's Plague.
I'll be showing symptoms\nsoon enough.
N-no... It can't be...
Why didn't you say\nanything!?
Sorry, Val. I just didn't\nwant you guys to panic.
Ngh...

But you're still fine now!
We can still treat you.
Hurry up and get on the
shuttle!

I can't take that risk. If it
kicks in while I'm aboard a
crowded shuttle, it'll be a
disaster. Just go on
without me.
Without you? But Ralph!
My little brother is already\naboard.
There's no way I'm letting\nhim get infected!
So please, I need you to\nleave me here.
But, you'll...
Hurry up. You're the one\nwho said we don't have\ntime, right?
So I boarded the shuttle\nand searched for Ralph's\nkid brother.
Eventually, I found Kurt.

That's why I'm keeping
Kurt safe! I owe it to my
friend for saving my
bacon!

That was a long story,
huh? Looks like we're
almost back at the Safety
Zone. C'mon, let's hurry.

Val, we figured out the
route to the Central
Control Room! And we've
even found Kurt!

Now you guys need to
rest here and let the
toxins from the gas pass
through you.
There's no time to stop\nand rest! Right, <player>!?
Heh, I knew you'd say\nthat! Now c'mon, let's go!
Whew... Phew... I finally\nmade it.
So, let's see... If I do this...
And finally, this.
Hehehe, I did it.
...Did you see that, bro?\nI...nailed it...
Kurt!!!
It's no good! He won't\nwake up!
Kurt! Hang in there,\nbuddy!
It looks like Kurt managed\nto unlock the entrance\nand shut off the gas!
Hurry, let's carry him\noutside!
Kurt...
I'm not lettin' you die,\ny'hear me!?
Everyone's here to see\nyou, buddy.
Are you okay, Kurt!? I was\nworried sick! My stress\ncircuits were in overdrive!
Pipe down, Coro! You'll\nmake him feel worse if you\ndon't stop shouting!
Hehehe, I'm okaaay! They\nsay I can go home soon.

Oh, thank goodness! You
organic beings and your
powers of recovery never
cease to impress.
Say, Terry, what's going\non here? Why is Val\nstanding so far away?
Oh, that? It's a silent\nprotest.
(Don't tell Val, but I think\nhe missed havin' Kurt\naround to lean on.)
(Oh, so he's feeling left\nout and wants some\nattention? How childish.)
That's not it at all! I'm\nMAD!

You rushed off into
danger all by yourself!
What's the point of having
friends like us if you don't
even trust 'em to help!?

You could've tried finding
us first so we could work
together on a safer
solution!
But no, you just did your\nown thing.
You're just like Ralph...\nMaking up your own mind\nwithout even talking to us.
Why are you in such a\nhurry to die!?
Val...
I'm so sorry...

But I didn't feel like I was
alone. I knew you guys
were with me all the way
to the Central Control
Room.
Huh? What do you mean?

Well, I could tell the
tower's surveillance
cameras were tracking
me.
And when I listened, I\ncould hear your footsteps\nin the distance.
No kiddin'! So you knew\neverythin' we were doin',\nKurt?

That's right. And I was
happy you both realized
what I was up to without
me even telling you.
It gave me the courage to\nkeep on going.
But I should've said it with\nwords, too. I'm sorry,\nguys...
Kurt...
I'm sorry, too!
You rushed in because\nyou trusted us, and yet I\ntreated you like a child...

I don't want to be a
burden to you guys. I want
to pull my weight and
protect you, too.
Yeah, you're a grown man,\nafter all! I need to\nremember that.
Just promise me one\nthing.
Don't just think about us,\nokay? Keep yourself alive,\ntoo!
Okay, I promise!
After all, I want to see the\nfuture Levarance we're\nbuilding, together.

You got it. No matter
what, we'll build a new
Levarance where
everyone's happy!
Aaand they're friends\nagain.
That's a relief.
But Val...
Aren'cha forgettin' YOUR\ninjuries? You should get\nback to your own room!

N-nah, don't worry about
me. I'd, er...rather stick
around here and help
nurse Kurt, y'know?

That's not what I heard.
The nurses said ya just
ran outta your room
'cause you were scared to
have an injection.
You're scared of needles,\nVal?
N-no way! Th-they're not\nscary at all! Not in the\nslightest...
Then let's getcha back to\nyour room, Val! That\nneedle won't inject itself.

N-no, seriously, I'm fine
now! Right as rain! No
need for needless
needles...
Enough talk! Move it!
Aaaaaaghhh, maaan! I hate\nneedles!
They're a lively bunch,\nalright. You wouldn't think\nthis was a hospital.
They may be wild, but\nthey're my best friends.
